guidanceConsulted.query: form autofill autocomplete attribute dynamic address forms detection
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Address forms should use correct autocomplete tokens so browser autofill can match fields; dynamic address forms must keep tokens accurate as fields change.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the example keeps spec-faithful autocomplete tokens (country, address-level1, postal-code) and the autofillValues/full-address prose explains matching via HTML autofill field names.

guidanceConsulted.query: form autofill autocomplete attribute dynamic address forms detection
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer native form semantics and avoid hidden-field hacks; document how autofill interacts with dynamic controls.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the 'why it exists' section explains the hidden-field anti-pattern this API replaces, matching the guidance's stance.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive documentation tables code blocks horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Data tables need header semantics and must stay readable on small screens without breaking layout.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: every table is wrapped in .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto} with table-layout:fixed and overflow-wrap:anywhere on cells; header cells use th.

guidanceConsulted.query: embedding third party iframe lazy loading performance
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Defer offscreen/heavy embeds so they don't compete with initial render.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the showcase iframe uses loading="lazy" and sits below the code example.
